name: Kale Salad with Poached Eggs, Beans & Warm Bacon-Shallot Dressing
instructions: Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Stack leaves on top of one another, then cut crosswise into thin (shred-like) ribbons. Place in a large bowl.
Sprinkle salt into the bowl with the kale. Using your hands, massage kale until slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add to the bowl with the wilted kale and set aside.
Peel and mince shallots. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add vinegar, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once the water in the pot is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low.
Gently crack eggs into additional small bowls (two eggs per bowl).

Adjust the heat of the pot as necessary so that the water is simmering. Working in batches if necessary, gently tip bowls into the pot, sliding the eggs carefully into the water. Cook until whites are set but yolks are still soft, 2½-3 minutes. Using the slotted spoon, transfer eggs to the plate with the bacon.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add oil, shallot, pepper, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.

Once the shallot has softened, remove from the heat. Whisk in the vinegar and Dijon, scraping the bottom of the skillet to incorporate any browned bits. Drizzle warm dressing into the bowl with the kale and beans. Toss to combine.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls. Top with crispy bacon and poached eggs. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
